attchmntText: Tarsons Products Limited has informed the Exchange about Presentation
voiceSummary: Tarsons Products Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, with BSE and NSE. Consolidated revenue for H1 FY27 reached 233.9 crore rupees, a 21% year-over-year increase. Standalone revenue grew 23% to 186.4 crore rupees. Consolidated profit after tax was negative 1.8 crore rupees, compared to positive 5.1 crore rupees in the prior year period. Standalone profit after tax was 3.8 crore rupees, down from 10.1 crore rupees. Margins were impacted by higher raw material prices and accelerated depreciation at new Amta and Panchla facilities. Cash profit after tax for H1 FY27 was 53.5 crore rupees on a consolidated basis and 54.2 crore rupees on a standalone basis. The presentation is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Tarsons Products Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Tarsons Products Limited has intimated the schedule for an analyst and institutional investor meeting. The event is hosted by Avendus Spark Group and will feature one-on-one meetings. It is scheduled for Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 11:00 A.M. Indian Standard Time. The meeting will be held in person in Mumbai. The company states that the schedule is subject to change due to exigencies. Discussions will be based on publicly available information. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared. This intimation is pursuant to SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations. The notice was issued by Santosh Kumar Agarwal, the CFO, Company Secretary, and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Tarsons Products Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Tarsons Products Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 12, 2026. Revenue from operations was 1236.50 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 1023.29 million for the same period in 2025. Profit for the period was 4.4 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 51.05 million for the same period in 2025. Earnings per equity share was 0.04 for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 0.62 for the same period in 2025. The results were reviewed by Price Waterhouse Chartered Accountants LLP.

attchmntText: Tarsons Products Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Tarsons Products Limited announced the approval of its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, by the Board of Directors on November 12, 2026. The consolidated revenue from operations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, stood at 1236.50 million, compared to 1023.29 million in the same period last year. The company reported a profit after tax of 6.26 million for the quarter, a reversal from the loss of 14.44 million in the previous quarter. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue was 2338.92 million, with a loss after tax of 17.88 million. Earnings per share for the quarter were 0.06. The results were reviewed by Price Waterhouse Chartered Accountants LLP, which issued an unmodified conclusion. The financials include results from subsidiaries in Singapore and Germany.
